source.title: Data Management Checklist - Dynamics 365 Implementation Guide
source.applicability: Provides implementation guidance for data governance, storage architecture, configuration data management, and data integration processes in enterprise systems

passages.locator: Data governance and architecture task list
passages.text: Define a data architecture that shows a holistic view of your data repositories, their relationships, and ownership. Identify the data owners, systems, and conceptual flow between systems during your design and analysis phases.
